drivers.why_material: The catalyst trial (NCT04447469) has a dual-cohort design with distinct registered primary endpoints for each cohort (Cohort 1: alive and free of mechanical ventilation at Day 29; Cohort 2: mortality rate at Day 29). The company presented only Cohort 1's primary as 'THE primary efficacy endpoint for the Phase 3 trial' (singular), omitting the existence of Cohort 2's distinct mortality-based primary. This misrepresents the trial structure and creates ambiguity about which success criterion governs the readout. This is trial-specific masking of the catalyst's actual registered endpoints.

As of August 2021, the company guided Q1 2022 readout as 'on-track' while the registered primary completion date was December 2021, implying year-end 2021 readout. This timeline inconsistency suggests potential awareness of operational issues not disclosed to investors.

In August 2021, the company claimed enrollment 'continues' when registry data shows enrollment was completed between March and August 2021 (status changed to ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING). Misrepresenting enrollment status suggests deliberate masking of trial progress.

analyst_note: The company materially misrepresented the structure of its COVID-19 Phase 2/3 trial going into topline. Most critically, it presented a single primary endpoint when the registered trial has two distinct cohorts with different primaries (ventilation-free survival vs. mortality), creating ambiguity about the success criterion. Additionally, the company claimed enrollment was ongoing in August 2021 when the registry shows it had already completed, and guided Q1 2022 readout as 'on-track' despite a December 2021 registered completion date. The endpoint manipulation is a severe red flag: selectively highlighting one cohort's endpoint while omitting the dual structure suggests pre-knowledge of differential performance. Multiple operational inconsistencies reinforce a pattern of masking around this specific catalyst.
